newsitem.title: INDIA: India Eicher calls off Skoda talks.
newsitem.headline: India Eicher calls off Skoda talks.

text.p: India's Eicher group said on Tuesday that it had decided to call off talks with Volkswagen AG's Czech automaker Skoda Mlada Boleslav to set up a planned joint venture to make cars in India.
"We are not at the moment talking with anyone for cars," Subodh Bhargava, chairman of the Eicher group, told a news conference.

"Eicher, given the prevailing market opportunities, and its high growth and investment plans for the existing businesses, has decided to suspend its plans for the car project," Eicher Goodearth Ltd, the group's holding company, said in a statement.
Eicher had been negotiating with Skoda to manufacture its Felicia model in India.

Bhargava, who is the chairman of the group's flagship Eicher Ltd, said Eicher decided that it would stick to growing opportunities in its existing businesses involving trucks, motorcycles, tractors and automobile components.

He said the car project, for which a memorandum of understanding had been signed in 1994 with the Volkswagen group, would have entailed an investment of 6.0 to 8.0 billion rupees in a new company, while demand in the car segment was not encouraging.
